summary: Read-only licence audit of the Reemtsma production org, run with --shared-admin. Salesforce licences are at 90.6% (29 of 32 used, 3 free) while 5 purchased Salesforce Integration licences sit at 0% usage and 14 of the 29 full licences are held by integration or service accounts. Two accounts dormant since 2023 still consume licences. Confirmed 4 shared privileged accounts plus one heavily shared marketing account (digital@reemtsma.de, 70 distinct source IPs, MFA explicitly disabled). Potential free licences after action: ~10 of 32, with no purchase required.

accounts.assessment: heavily shared human account with MFA off - worst case

shared_admin.core_argument: A passkey is bound to a person and a device and cannot be copied or handed over. A shared account therefore either collapses to one person (undocumented single point of failure), shares the authenticator (losing phishing resistance and attribution), or keeps a weaker exemption (the most privileged account gets the weakest authentication). No configuration resolves this - the fix is organisational.
recommended_patterns: 1: named accounts + Permission Set Groups for humans
2: API-only integration user (no interactive login, so no passkey question) for systems
3: just-in-time elevation for occasional admin needs
4: at most one break-glass account - vault-sealed, passkey held by a named security owner, alerted on every login, rotated after use

not_verified: Per-licence pricing and contract terms - no monetary figure quoted
Current passkey / phishing-resistant MFA requirement and timeline - changes frequently, must be confirmed in Setup and current Salesforce docs
Whether the Seco, Tobaccoland and e-commerce interfaces are still operating
Whether digital@ and lettershopservice@ are genuinely shared or single users on rotating mobile IPs
Whether Einstein Agent / CRM User feature licences are separately contracted
org_changes_made: none - read-only audit. Only SELECT queries against UserLicense, PermissionSetLicense, User, PermissionSetAssignment and LoginHistory. No user deactivated or frozen, no licence reassigned, no permission set or profile modified.
output: Full report at org_assessment/2026-08-13-user-licenses-review.md: licence inventory with utilisation, licence-fit breakdown of all 29 Salesforce-licence holders, dormancy and reclamation analysis, shared admin findings with login-source diversity evidence, the passkey argument, four recommended patterns with a concrete recommendation, a 7-step migration outline, a 9-item action plan, and 5 verification gaps.
